program.merge_policy: accumulate eight 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after 200

reconciliation_note: Pass 1 intentionally captures unused historical randomized human source identities already represented in canonical claim data. These are baseline/history nodes, not freshness signals; later passes prioritize newer evidence and contradiction/safety updates.

policy.validation_strategy: cheap duplicate/entity/source screening during authoring; expensive repository-wide validation only after Wave 700
